name: wrap-cheat
title: Gift wrapping *cheat sheet*

rows.name: The *length* rule
rows.note: Wrap it around the box, then add 2 inches of overlap

rows.name: The *ends* rule
rows.note: Paper past each end, just over the box's height

rows.name: The *tape* rule
rows.note: Tape under the seams, so none shows

rows.name: The *ribbon* rule
rows.note: Go around both ways, plus extra for the bow
